scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Hm...?
Ah, I sense that you are a warrior that has been to Valhalla. You who have been reborn... We are here to look after you.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
嗯...？
啊，我感受到你是一位曾到過瓦爾哈拉的勇士。
重生的你...我們會在這裡照看你。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Do not let evil conquer your soul. You have enough courage and power to overcome the hardest situation. May God bless you...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
別讓邪惡侵佔你的靈魂。
你有足夠的勇氣和力量，渡過最艱難的困境。
願上帝保佑你...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Ah...
It is good to see you again, Brother {0}. Once again, God's grace has caused our paths to cross.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
啊...很高興再見到你，{0}兄弟。
上帝的恩典，讓我們再次相遇。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Ah...
It is good to see you once again, Sister {0}. The grace of God has brought you once more before me.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
啊...很高興再見到你，{0}姐妹。
上帝的恩典，再次將你帶到我面前。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I'm pleased to see that you are continuing to lead the children of God on the right path. Is there anything I can help you with today?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
很高興看到你在繼續引導上帝的子民走上正途。今天有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: How is your health?
scripts.translation: 您的身體還好嗎？

scripts.text: I want to help this Acolyte.
scripts.translation: 我想幫助這位服事

scripts.text: Father, I need your help.
scripts.translation: 神父，我需要您的幫助

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Thank you for your concern. I'm doing fine and am in good health. Please give my regards to your brothers and sisters.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
感謝關心，我一切安好，身體也很健康。
請代我向你的兄弟姐妹們問好。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Keep in mind that we are God's messengers on this Earth. Always remember that we must always help others.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
記住，我們是上帝在人間的使者。
無論何時，都應幫助他人。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Ah, that's a good idea. Helping young Acolytes should also be one of a Priest's priorities.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
啊，這是個好主意。幫助年輕的服事也應該是牧師的首要任務之一。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
However, there are certain things that an Acolyte must do alone. All Acolytes must complete their divine test by themselves.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
不過，有些事情服事必須獨自完成。所有服事都必須獨自完成神聖的考驗。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I hope you will assist your Acolyte friend in the second test, the spiritual training.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
希望你能在第二項考驗——靈性修行中，幫助你的服事朋友。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You need to bring ^0000FF1 Rosary^000000 in order to accompany an Acolyte in spiritual training. If you have one of those, I can send you to the test area now.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
陪同服事參加靈性修行，需要攜帶^0000FF1個念珠^000000。
帶了的話，我現在就能送你去考場。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Do you wish to help him out during the spiritual training?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
你願意在靈性修行中幫助他嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 是的，我願意

scripts.text: Give me a second.
scripts.translation: 請稍等一下

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I will now send you to the training place for Acolytes. Please send my regards to Brother Peter...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
現在送你去服事的修行場所。
請代我向彼得兄弟問好...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I hope you will assist this Acolyte in becoming a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
我希望你能協助這位服事成為牧師。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Unfortunately you didn't bring a ^0000FFRosary^000000. You need one of those in order to be in the testing area.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
可惜，你沒帶^0000FF念珠^000000。
必須帶一個，才能進入考場。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I see, take your time. Don't forget to bring a ^0000FFRosary^000000...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
明白了，慢慢準備。
別忘了帶^0000FF念珠^000000...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You must be strong. Have faith, as you are loved by God. I pray the wounds of the body are healed soon...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
要堅強，也要堅守信仰，上帝愛著你。
我祈禱你身上的傷早日痊癒...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
God, please look after your poor children. Help them overcome their hardships and difficulties. Refresh their spirits...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
上帝啊，請眷顧您受苦的子民。
幫助他們渡過艱難困苦，讓他們重振精神...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I hope my invocation has eased your pain. Now please go forth and spread God's message. May God be with you...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
願我的祈禱能減輕你的痛苦。
去傳播上帝的旨意吧。
願上帝與你同在...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
May God be
with you, brother.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
願上帝與你同在，兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
May God be
with you, sister.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
願上帝與你同在，姐妹。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You are in
the Sanctuary.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
這裡是聖堂。
你來這裡有什麼事？

scripts.text: I want to be an Acolyte.
scripts.translation: 我想成為服事

scripts.text: I want to be a Priest.
scripts.translation: 我想成為牧師

scripts.text: Nothing, really.
scripts.translation: 其實沒什麼事

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Oh I see...
If you wish to become an Acolyte, please visit the other room.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
原來如此...
如果你想成為服事，請去隔壁的房間。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Oh I see. However, you must first become an Acolyte before becoming a Priest. Please visit the other room.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
原來如此。不過，你必須先成為服事，才能成為牧師。請去隔壁的房間。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Please make yourself at home. On Earth, nowhere is safer than this Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
請自便。在世間，沒有比這座聖堂更安全的地方了。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
May God bless you.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
願上帝保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
May God be
with you, brother.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
願上帝與你同在，兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
May God be
with you, sister.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
願上帝與你同在，姐妹。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
What brings you here
to Prontera Sanctuary?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
你來普隆德拉聖堂有什麼事？

scripts.text: Information about Priests.
scripts.translation: 瞭解牧師

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Priests have the authority to perform and administer religious rites.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
牧師有權主持宗教儀式。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You must first be thoroughly disciplined as an Acolyte before you can be promoted to the position of Priest.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
要晉升為牧師，必須先以服事的身份接受嚴格的修行。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
When you reach Acolyte Job level 40, you will be able to apply for the Priest test.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
服事職業等級達到40級，就可以申請參加牧師考驗。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
If you pass the test, you will be able to use more powerful skills that will be effective against Demon and Undead creatures...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
通過考驗後，你就能使用更強大的技能，有效對抗惡魔與不死系生物...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
With all of your ability, you will play an important role in towns and dungeons.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
憑藉這些能力，你將在城鎮和地下城中發揮重要作用。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Our duty and obligation as Priests is to devote ourselves to helping others without expecting reward.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
作為牧師，我們的職責和義務是無私奉獻，幫助他人，而不求任何回報。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
As we help others, we must not expect to treat us in a similar fashion. To be a great Priest is your choice and responsibility, not anyone else's.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
幫助他人時，不應期待對方給予同樣的回報。
成為優秀的牧師，是你自己的選擇和責任，不是別人的。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
However, those who receive should be polite. You should give an outstanding example, but you should also have your limits as a human.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
不過，接受幫助的人也應有禮貌。
你應當以身作則，但身為凡人，也有自己的限度。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I hope I explained enough of the class. Why don't you go outside and talk to some of the other Priests if you want to learn more about our way of life?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
關於這個職業，我想已經說明得夠多了。
若想進一步瞭解牧師的生活，不妨去外面和其他牧師聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Please make yourself at home. Nowhere on Earth is safer than the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
請自便。普隆德拉聖堂是世上最安全的地方。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Well...
May God
bless you.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
那麼...願上帝保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
May God bless
you, Brother.
What brings
you to me?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
願上帝保佑你，兄弟。
有什麼事找我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
May God bless
you, Sister.
What brings
you to me?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
願上帝保佑你，姐妹。
有什麼事找我嗎？

scripts.text: I want to be a Priest.
scripts.translation: 我想成為牧師

scripts.text: How are you, Father?
scripts.translation: 神父，您近來可好？

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I see. So you wish to be a Priest. God will be delighted by your decision and will bless you.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
原來如此，你想成為牧師。
上帝會因你的決定而喜悅，並賜福於你。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I am Bishop Paul Cervantes, and am in charge of the Prontera Parish.
I am glad to meet a person as eager and devoted to God such as yourself.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
我是保羅·塞萬提斯主教，負責普隆德拉教區。
很高興遇到像你這樣熱忱、虔誠侍奉上帝的人。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
If you set your mind on becoming a Priest, you must undergo several tests. Only Acolytes who reach job level 40 are qualified for testing.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
決心成為牧師，就必須接受幾項考驗。
只有職業等級達到40級的服事，才有資格參加。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
If you satisfy the requirements, I suggest that you apply for the Priest job first. Do you wish to apply now?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
若已符合條件，我建議先提交牧師轉職申請。
現在要申請嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 是的，我要申請

scripts.text: I need some time to think about it...
scripts.translation: 我需要時間考慮一下...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You are not yet qualified to be a Priest. Please go out into the world and broaden your experiences.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
你還不符合成為牧師的條件。請去外面的世界歷練，豐富你的閱歷吧。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
There are still things that you must learn as an Acolyte. However, I look forward to meeting you again very soon.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
作為服事，你還有很多東西要學。不過，我期待很快能再次見到你。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You have skill points left.
I strongly recommend that you use all of these skill points before you apply for the Priest job change test.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
你還有剩餘的技能點。
我強烈建議你在申請牧師轉職測試之前，把這些技能點全部用完。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Now I will explain the Three Trials of Priesthood. These tribulations will bring you much suffering, but I hope you can complete them, Brother {0}.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
現在，我來說明牧師的三重試煉。
這些考驗會帶來不少苦難，但願你能完成，{0}兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Now I will explain the Three Trials of Priesthood. These tribulations will bring you much suffering, but I hope you can complete them, Sister {0}.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
現在，我來說明牧師的三重試煉。
這些考驗會帶來不少苦難，但願你能完成，{0}姐妹。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
For the First Trial, you will make a pilgrimage, and visit three acscetic Priests in a specific order.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
第一重試煉是朝聖，按指定順序拜訪三位苦修的牧師。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
The Second Trial will consist of spiritual training. You must resist the temptations of Demons and the Undead.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
第二重試煉是靈性修行。
你必須抵禦惡魔與不死者的誘惑。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
In the Final Trial, you will promise your devotion to God. Your willingness to sacrifice yourself will also be questioned.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
最後一重試煉，你要向上帝宣誓虔誠奉獻。
你是否願意犧牲自己，也會受到考驗。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Acolytes that have reached Job Level 50 will be exempt from the First Trial, the pilgrimage, as they have already demonstrated their enthusiasm and devotion.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
職業等級達到50級的服事，已證明自己的熱忱與虔誠，可以免去第一重試煉——朝聖。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I can see the great effort you have exerted to reach job level 50. You have been a loyal servant to God.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
我看得出，你為達到職業等級50級付出了許多努力。
你一直是上帝忠誠的僕人。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Now, you may go directly go to the Second Trial: Spiritual Training. For this training, you may bring a Priest with you.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
現在，你可以直接參加第二重試煉——靈性修行。
這項修行可以請一位牧師同行。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I have no doubt that you will do a good job by yourself. However, it will be easier with the aid of a Brother or Sister that has already become a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
我相信你獨自也能完成得很好。
不過，有已成為牧師的兄弟姐妹協助，會容易一些。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Well, are you ready for the Spiritual Training?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
準備好參加靈性修行了嗎？

scripts.text: I am ready.
scripts.translation: 我準備好了

scripts.text: Give me a minute.
scripts.translation: 請稍等一下

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Good. I will send you to the training ground. When you get there, please speak to Brother Peter who is in charge of the training.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
好，我送你去修行場地。
到了後，請找負責修行的彼得兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
No problem, take your time.
May God give you the strength to overcome your fears...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
無妨，慢慢準備。
願上帝賜你克服恐懼的力量...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Well, let me tell you the order of the ascetic Priests that you must visit for your pilgrimage.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
我來說明朝聖時拜訪三位苦修牧師的順序。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
First, please visit Father
Rubalkabara who is Northeast
of the Prontera Ruins.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
首先，請拜訪位於普隆德拉廢墟東北方的魯巴爾卡巴拉神父。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Second, please visit Sister Mathilda. She is located in
an area near Morocc, Southwest of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
其次，拜訪瑪蒂爾達修女。
她在普隆德拉西南方、夢羅克附近。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
The third Priest you must visit is Father Yosuke. He is in a field Northwest of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
第三位是陽介神父。
他在普隆德拉西北方的野外。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Well then, I wish you a safe journey. If you have any questions, please ask Sister Cecilia.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
那麼，祝你旅途平安。如果有任何問題，請詢問塞西莉亞修女。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
When you return from your pilgrimage, I will let you know
of the next test.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
朝聖歸來後，我會說明下一項考驗。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
May God
bless you...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
願上帝保佑你...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Please take your time.
You are always welcomed.
May God bless you...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
慢慢考慮。
這裡隨時歡迎你。
願上帝保佑你...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I see...
I am doing fine
and am in good health.
Thank you for asking.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
原來如此...我一切安好，身體也很健康。
感謝你的關心。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I hope you will continue to go on your mission as God's servant, brother.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
兄弟，願你繼續履行上帝僕人的使命。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I hope you will continue to go on your mission as God's servant, sister.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
姐妹，願你繼續履行上帝僕人的使命。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Hopefully, our paths
will cross again.
May God bless you...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
希望我們還能再次相遇。
願上帝保佑你...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
May I ask you the reason you're still here? You didn't forget your pilgrimage, did you?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
請問你為什麼還在這裡？你沒有忘記你的朝聖之旅吧？

scripts.text: Sorry father, I need to check the order.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，神父，我想確認拜訪順序

scripts.text: No no no, not at all.
scripts.translation: 不不不，完全沒忘

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Ah, I see. I will let you know the order of pilgrimage again, and hope that you will have a safe journey.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
原來如此，我再說一遍朝聖的順序。
願你旅途平安。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
First, meet Father Rubalkabara. He's at the Northeast of the Prontera ruins.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
首先，拜訪魯巴爾卡巴拉神父。
他在普隆德拉廢墟東北方。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Then, remember to meet Sister Mathilda. She's somewhere near the town of Morocc, Southwest of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
然後，記得拜訪瑪蒂爾達修女。
她在普隆德拉西南方、夢羅克附近。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
And lastly, please seek out Father Yosuke. He is in the a field Northwest of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
最後，尋找陽介神父。
他在普隆德拉西北方的野外。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Well then, I shall pray for your safe journey. If you want more information, please ask Sister Cecilia.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
那麼，我會為你祈禱旅途平安。如果你需要更多資訊，請去問塞西莉亞修女。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
When you get back from the pilgrimage, I will let you know the next test.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
朝聖歸來後，我會說明下一項考驗。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
May God bless you...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
願上帝保佑你...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I see. But still, if you have any questions, you may wish to ask Sister Cecilia. She will address any of your concerns.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
我明白了。不過，如果你有任何問題，不妨去問問塞西莉亞修女。她會解答你的疑惑。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Well then, I shall pray for your safe journey. May God bless you...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
那麼，我會祈禱你旅途平安。
願上帝保佑你...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I see you have returned from your meeting with Father Rubalkabara. How is he doing? I am worried about his health, since he's been there all alone...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
看來你拜訪魯巴爾卡巴拉神父回來了。
他近來如何？他一直獨自在那裡，我很擔心他的身體...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
For your next quest, you should meet Sister Mathilda. I shall be awaiting your safe return.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
接下來，去拜訪瑪蒂爾達修女。
我會等你平安歸來。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I see that you have returned from your journey to meet Sister Mathilda. She has been meditating in the hot, dry desert for a long time.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
看來你拜訪瑪蒂爾達修女回來了。
她已在炎熱乾燥的沙漠中冥想許久。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Finally, it is now time for you to meet Father Yosuke. He is doing penance somewhere around a field Northwest of Prontera. Please seek him out, and then return here to me.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
最後，該去拜訪陽介神父了。
他在普隆德拉西北方的野外苦修贖罪。
找到他後，再回來見我。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You've accomplished
your pilgrimage.
Congratulations.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
你完成了你的朝聖之旅。
恭喜你。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Now it is time to begin your spiritual training. As I mentioned before, you may bring a Priest to help you during this training.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
現在，該開始靈性修行了。
之前說過，這項修行可以請一位牧師來協助。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Although you cannot receive their help throughout all of the testing, they can at least help you during the spiritual training.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
雖然不是每項考驗都能得到他們的幫助，但靈性修行期間，可以請他們協助。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Well, are you ready for
the spiritual training?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
準備好參加靈性修行了嗎？

scripts.text: I'm ready.
scripts.translation: 我準備好了

scripts.text: Give me a minute.
scripts.translation: 請稍等一下

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Good. I will send you to the training ground. When you get there, please speak to Brother Peter who is in charge of the training.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
好，我送你去修行場地。
到了後，請找負責修行的彼得兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
No problem,
take your time.
May God grant you
the strength to
overcome your fears...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
無妨，慢慢準備。
願上帝賜你克服恐懼的力量...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You seem confident about the spiritual training. Shall we begin?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
看來你對靈性修行很有信心。
開始吧？

scripts.text: I'm ready.
scripts.translation: 我準備好了

scripts.text: Give me a minute.
scripts.translation: 請稍等一下

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Good. I will send you to the training ground. When you get there, please speak to Brother Peter who is in charge of the training.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
好，我送你去修行場地。
到了後，請找負責修行的彼得兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
No problem,
take your time.
May God grant you
the strength to
overcome your fears...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
無妨，慢慢準備。
願上帝賜你克服恐懼的力量...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You look tired and exhausted. However, you must endure even more suffering once you become a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
你看起來很疲憊。不過，一旦成為牧師，你必須忍受更多的苦難。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Please endure these trials for the sake of your dream. Why don't you challenge the spiritual training again?
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
為了夢想，請堅持完成這些考驗。
再挑戰一次靈性修行吧？

scripts.text: I'll try again.
scripts.translation: 我再試一次

scripts.text: Give me a minute.
scripts.translation: 請稍等一下

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Good. I will send you to the training ground. Please ask for help from Brother Peter.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
好，我送你去修行場地。
請向彼得兄弟尋求幫助。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
No problem,
take your time.
May God grant you
the strength to
overcome your fears...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
無妨，慢慢準備。
願上帝賜你克服恐懼的力量...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
I am glad that you've done well with the spiritual training. Congratulations. You are now qualified to be called a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
很高興你順利完成靈性修行。
恭喜，你已經有資格成為牧師。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Now, you must go and swear your devotion to God with Sister Cecilia. Don't be nervous...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
現在，去找塞西莉亞修女，向上帝宣誓虔誠奉獻。
別緊張...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Just answer honestly, and listen to the voice of God that speaks quietly in your heart.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
只需誠實回答，並傾聽上帝在你心中輕聲的話語。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Well then...
I will be here
waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
那麼...我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Hmm? You haven't made your oath yet...? Without the conviction of an oath to God, you may be tempted by evil at anytime.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
嗯？還沒宣誓...？
若沒有向上帝立誓的堅定信念，隨時都可能受到邪惡誘惑。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You should go to sister Cecilia and promise your devotion to God. Return here with honor, and listen to the voice of God that speaks quietly in your heart.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
去找塞西莉亞修女，向上帝許下奉獻的誓言。
光榮地歸來，傾聽上帝在你心中輕聲訴說的話語。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You have remaining skills points. Please use these skill points to upgrade your skills, and then return to me.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
你還有剩餘的技能點。請使用這些技能點升級你的技能，然後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Congratulations, you have completed the trials required of all Priests. Let me promote you to the position of Priest right away.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
恭喜，你完成了所有牧師必須經歷的考驗。
現在就授予你牧師的身份。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
God, grant your power to your servant standing before you.
Let him send your message throughout the ends of the earth.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
上帝啊，請將您的力量賜予面前的僕人。
讓他將您的旨意傳至天涯海角。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
God, grant your power to your servant standing before you.
Let her send your message throughout the ends of the earth.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
上帝啊，請將您的力量賜予面前的僕人。
讓她將您的旨意傳至天涯海角。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Make this servant of yours an instrument of your miraculous works...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
讓您的這位僕人成為施行神蹟的器皿...

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
Now you are born again as a Priest. I congratulate you, and hope you will greatly help other people for the rest of your life.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
如今，你以牧師的身份獲得新生。
恭喜你，願你在往後的歲月裡，盡心幫助他人。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
This book is for you. I hope it will aid you in spreading God's message on earth.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
這本書送給你。我希望它能幫助你向世人傳播上帝的旨意。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
In commemoration of your job change, I am giving you a bible. This will lighten your way to the path of righteousness.
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
為紀念你的轉職，贈你一本聖經。
它會照亮你通往正義的道路。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Paul]
You've shown great effort, and have made admirable progress in your personal quest for holiness. Please lead your life as a sincere Priest...
scripts.translation:
[主教 保羅]
你付出了許多努力，在追求聖潔的道路上取得了令人欽佩的進步。
願你以真誠之心，履行牧師的職責...

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
May god bless you, {0}.
Prontera parish welcomes you.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
願上帝保佑你，{0}。
普隆德拉教區歡迎你。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
May god bless you, {0}.
Welcome to Prontera parish. How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
願上帝保佑你，{0}。
歡迎來到普隆德拉教區。有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
May god bless you, {0}. It brings my heart joy to see that you working hard to carry out the will of God.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
願上帝保佑你，{0}。
看到你努力踐行上帝的旨意，我很欣慰。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
May God bless you, brother.
May I ask what brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
願上帝保佑你，兄弟。
請問你為何而來？

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
May God bless you, sister.
May I ask what brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
願上帝保佑你，姐妹。
請問你為何而來？

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Ah, you've started your pilgrimage. Please do your best to accomplish this first trial.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
啊，你已踏上朝聖之旅。
請盡力完成第一重試煉。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Oh, you've met Father Rubalkabara. Now it's time for you to visit Sister Mathilda. She is near a town named Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
哦，你見過魯巴爾卡巴拉神父了。
現在該去拜訪瑪蒂爾達修女，她在夢羅克城附近。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Now, the final Priest that you must meet is Father Yosuke. I've heard that he is training near a lake located Northwest of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
最後要拜訪的是陽介神父。
聽說他在普隆德拉西北方的湖邊修行。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Welcome. You demonstrated great effort to accomplish your first trial. Now, speak to Bishop Paul so that you can begin your next trial on your path to Priesthood.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
歡迎回來，你努力完成了第一重試煉。
去找保羅主教，開始牧師之路上的下一重試煉吧。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Oh, you haven't finished the spiritual training yet?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
哦，還沒完成靈性修行嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Yes, I understand that you've been through a really difficult situation. However, do not give up and succumb to temptation. You must be able to resist evil to become a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
我明白，你經歷了艱難的考驗。
但不要放棄，也不要屈服於誘惑。
想成為牧師，就必須抵禦邪惡。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
...

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Welcome! I'm so glad to see you've come back! Now, there is one last trial left for you to complete.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
歡迎回來！很高興又見到你！
現在只剩最後一重試煉了。

scripts.text: [Sister Cecilia]
scripts.translation: [塞西莉亞修女]

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Congratulations.
You've completed all three trials required for the Priesthood. Bishop Paul is now waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
恭喜，你完成了成為牧師所需的全部三重試煉。
保羅主教正在等你。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Oh, you haven't chosen a job yet? Why don't you consider devoting your life to God?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
哦，你還沒有選擇職業嗎？為什麼不考慮將你的生命奉獻給上帝呢？

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
You can lead a fulfilling life as an Acolyte, helping out other people in need.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
作為服事，你可以過上充實的生活，幫助那些需要幫助的人。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
If you're interested, please ask the Priest in the other room. You won't ever regret the choice to become an Acolyte.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
如果你感興趣，請去隔壁房間找牧師諮詢。你絕不會後悔選擇成為服事。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
When you reach Job level 40 as an Acolyte, you can be promoted to a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
當你的服事職業等級達到40級時，你可以晉升為牧師。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
But please...
Take your time, and decide what job will be the best for you.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
不過...不必著急，慢慢考慮哪個職業最適合你。

scripts.text: Tell me more about Priests.
scripts.translation: 請多講些牧師的事

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Messengers of God are usually known as Priests. After becoming an Acolyte, you can train with the goal of becoming a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
上帝的使者，通常被稱為牧師。
成為服事後，就可以朝著牧師的目標修行。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Servants of God are prohibited to use weapons based on blades. For us, the meaning of battle with monsters is not in the killing, but in the enlightening of their souls.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
上帝的僕人不得使用刀劍類武器。
對我們而言，與魔物戰鬥不是為了殺戮，而是為了啟迪它們的靈魂。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
I see. Well, feel free to relax and make yourself at home. Nowhere on earth is safer than the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
我明白了。請放鬆，把這裡當作你的家。世界上沒有比普隆德拉聖堂更安全的地方了。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
May God bless you...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
願上帝保佑你...

scripts.text: I wish to become a Priest.
scripts.translation: 我想成為牧師

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
I see. You've devoted yourself to God. Many Acolytes wish to become Priests to continue on their personal journey towards holiness.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
原來如此，你已決心奉獻於上帝。
許多服事都想成為牧師，繼續走在追求聖潔的道路上。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Let me introduce myself. I am Cecilia Margarita, and I am in charge of part of the Priest job change process.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
自我介紹一下，我是塞西莉亞·瑪格麗塔，負責牧師轉職的部分考驗。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
I've been supporting many people in becoming Priests ever since I joined the Prontera Parish. That is one of my main responsibilities.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
加入普隆德拉教區以來，我幫助了許多人成為牧師。
這是我的主要職責之一。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
In order to become a Priest, you must complete 3 trials. A pilgrimage, a session of spiritual training, and an oath of devotion to God.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
想成為牧師，必須完成三重試煉：朝聖、靈性修行，以及向上帝宣誓奉獻。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
If you wish to become a servant of God, please apply for the Priest job with Bishop Paul, and complete all 3 trials.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
想成為上帝的僕人，請向保羅主教申請轉職為牧師，並完成三重試煉。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
If you experience a problem during any of your trials, feel free to visit me. I will help you as much as I can.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
如果你在考驗中遇到任何問題，請隨時來找我。我會盡我所能幫助你。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Make yourself at home. I insist that you recover and take a rest in this Sanctuary. May God bless you...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
不必拘束，請務必在聖堂裡好好休息，恢復體力。
願上帝保佑你...

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
The first Priest you must meet is Father Rubalkabara. He is in the ruins Northeast of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
你必須見的第一位牧師是魯巴爾卡巴拉神父。他在普隆德拉東北方的廢墟中。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Travel one field North from Prontera, and then three fields East, and you will arrive at the ruins.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
從普隆德拉向北走一張地圖，再向東走三張地圖，就能到廢墟。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Of course, you can also head 1 field East from Prontera, then go 1 field north, and then go 2 fields East...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
也可以先從普隆德拉向東走一張地圖，再向北走一張，最後向東走兩張...

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Father Rubalkabara will be at the entrance of the Prontera Ruins. Be careful. That place is a habitat for aggressive Chocos.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
魯巴爾卡巴拉神父在普隆德拉廢墟入口。
小心，那裡有會主動攻擊的巧克猴。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
After meeting Father Rubalkabara, please visit Sister Mathilda and Father Yosuke. You can check your quest progress with me if you have any questions later.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
拜訪魯巴爾卡巴拉神父後，再去拜訪瑪蒂爾達修女和陽介神父。
之後若有疑問，可以來找我確認任務進度。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Well then, have a good journey. Please don't give up to short lived tribulations, and I hope that you accomplish your goals.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
那麼，祝你旅途愉快。請不要因短暫的磨難而放棄，希望你能達成自己的目標。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
She has been training her religious discipline somewhere in a field North of Morocc. If you look around that field, you will be able to find her.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
她在夢羅克北方的野外修行。
在那張地圖四處找找，就能找到她。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Of course, sometimes I want to devote myself to training like those other Priests, but I have my duty to assist those Acolytes applying for the Priest job.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
當然，有時我也想像其他牧師那樣專心修行，但我有責任協助那些申請成為牧師的服事。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
But I believe this is God's will, and that this is the work he has intended me to do as his servant. Have a safe journey, and come back safely.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
但我相信，這是上帝的旨意，是祂安排我這個僕人履行的職責。
願你旅途平安，安全歸來。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
From Prontera, travel one field North, and then two fields towards the West. You may also travel two fields West first, and then travel one field to the North.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
從普隆德拉向北走一張地圖，再向西走兩張。
也可以先向西走兩張，再向北走一張。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Although there are still two trials awaiting you, I have faith that you will be able to accomplish your goal of becoming a Priest...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
雖然還有兩項考驗等著你，但我相信你能達成成為牧師的目標...

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Brother {0}...
The spiritual training is much more difficult than the pilgrimage, but I believe in you.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
{0}兄弟...
靈性修行比朝聖艱難得多，但我相信你。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Sister {0}...
The spiritual training is much more difficult than the pilgrimage, but I believe in you.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
{0}姐妹...
靈性修行比朝聖艱難得多，但我相信你。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
I hope that you find someone who has already become a Priest to help during the spiritual training. Good luck, and have faith.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
希望你能找一位牧師，在靈性修行中幫助你。
祝你好運，要堅守信仰。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
I cannot let you know the specific details, but as long as you believe in yourself and have faith in all that is good, you will succeed.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
我不能告訴你具體的細節，但只要你相信自己，並對一切美好事物保持信心，你就會成功。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Please speak to Father Peter in the test hall for more details. He is a close friend of Bishop Paul and may give you some useful tips for the spiritual training.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
詳細情況，請去考場問彼得神父。
他是保羅主教的好友，也許能給你一些靈性修行的建議。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
If you know somebody who has already become a Priest, ask them to help you during your spiritual training.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
若認識已經成為牧師的人，就請他們在靈性修行中幫你。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
May God give you guidance and protection. When you complete your training, please come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
願上帝指引並保護你。完成修行後，請回到我這裡。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Welcome back.
I hope that you've reflected on what you've said last time, and that you now have the attitude to become a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
歡迎回來。
希望你已經反省過上次說的話，如今有了成為牧師應有的心態。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Brother {0}...
We will now begin your formal oath for the Priesthood. Make yourself comfortable, and just answer with your heart.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
{0}兄弟...
現在，正式開始牧師宣誓。
放輕鬆，依照本心回答就好。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Sister {0}...
We will now begin your formal oath for the Priesthood. Make yourself comfortable, and just answer with your heart.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
{0}姐妹...
現在，正式開始牧師宣誓。
放輕鬆，依照本心回答就好。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Brother {0},
Are you willing
to give your life to God?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
{0}兄弟，你願意將生命奉獻給上帝嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Sister {0},
Are you willing
to give your life to God?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
{0}姐妹，你願意將生命奉獻給上帝嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No!
scripts.translation: 不！

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Aw...? How could you give me that kind of answer? I assume you're not ready to be a Priest yet...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
哎呀...？你怎麼能給出這樣的回答呢？看來你還沒有準備好成為一名牧師...

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
You should reflect a little more on the teachings of holiness and come back later. You can't be a Priest if your spirit is weak.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
再用心體悟聖潔的教誨，之後再來吧。
心志不堅定，是不能成為牧師的。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Will you take advantage of the holy abilities given by God for selfish, destructive or greedy ends?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
你會為滿足私慾、破壞或貪婪，濫用上帝賜予的神聖力量嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不會

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Aw...? God won't grant you the power of holiness if your goals aren't just and pure. Meditate on your motivations for a while, and then come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
啊...？目的若不正義、純潔，上帝不會賜予你神聖力量。
靜心反思自己的動機，再來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Think about the qualities that make Priests people of respect. You can't be a Priest if your spirit is not in accordance with God.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
想想看，牧師具備哪些受人尊敬的品質。
心靈若不順從上帝，就無法成為牧師。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Will you help aid others, even complete strangers, in battles by easing their suffering?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
你願意在戰鬥中幫助他人、減輕他們的痛苦，即使對方是素不相識的人嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不願意

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
No, no. You've got the wrong idea. God authorizes us to use his power to support his children. You must help people in danger: it is your obligation.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
不，你想錯了。
上帝賜予我們力量，是為了扶助祂的子民。
幫助身陷危險的人，是你的義務。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Go and observe the adventurers that are fighting for peace in this world. They will teach you what you must do in order to help them.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
去看看那些為世界和平而戰的冒險者吧。
從他們身上，你會明白該怎樣幫助他們。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Are you willing to sacrifice yourself for the sake of others?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
你願意為他人犧牲自己嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不願意

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
How can you say no...? That's one of the basic principles of Priesthood. You must value the welfare of others over your own safety.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
你怎麼能說“不”呢...？這是牧師的基本準則之一。你必須將他人的福祉置於自己的安全之上。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Go and think about the value of suffering and the meaning of sacrifice. When you think you understand more about helping those in need, come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
去想想痛苦的價值和犧牲的意義。當你覺得自己更懂得如何幫助有需要的人時，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Will you repeatly say the same phrase in public in order to send God's message to his children?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
為了向上帝的子民傳達祂的旨意，你會在公共場合不停重複同一句話嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不會

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
No no no... You've got it wrong. Even though your purpose is to spread God's message, no one will eagerly accept what you say when you spam text.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
不不不...你想錯了。
即使是為了傳播上帝的旨意，不停刷屏，也不會有人樂意聽。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Remember...
You must be a moral person, and display maturity and respect to other players. This kind of attitude applies for all classes,
I believe.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
記住...要有良好的品行，成熟行事，尊重其他玩家。
我相信，這份要求適用於所有職業。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Will you lure many monsters to help your party members level up?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
為了幫助隊友升級，你會引來大群魔物嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不會

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
No, you won't. Luring many monsters does more harm than good. There is no exception. That behavior is totally unacceptable.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
不，不該這樣做。
引來大群魔物弊大於利，沒有例外。
這種行為完全不可接受。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Even if it looks like you are aiding your party members, such action results in bad karma. Please reflect on that for a while.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
看似是在幫隊友，實際卻會招致惡果。
請好好反思。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Will you follow God, no matter what it takes, even if he demands you to kill yourself?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
無論付出什麼代價，你都願意追隨上帝，即使祂要求你結束自己的生命嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不願意

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
With that spirit, you can't be a Priest. If it is God's will to sacrifice yourself for a good purpose, you must carry out God's will as his servant.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
抱著這樣的心態，是不能成為牧師的。
若上帝要你為善而犧牲，身為祂的僕人，就應遵行祂的旨意。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Besides, God has also given Priests the resurrection power. Think about the meaning of life and death again, and then come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
此外，上帝也賦予了牧師復活的力量。請重新思考生與死的意義，然後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Brother {0}...
You have demonstrated your devotion to God. Will you swear to adhere to his teachings for the rest of your days?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
{0}兄弟...
你已展現出對上帝的虔誠。你願意發誓，餘生都遵循他的教誨嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Sister {0}...
You have demonstrated your devotion to God. Will you swear to adhere to his teachings for the rest of your days?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
{0}姐妹...
你已展現出對上帝的虔誠。你願意發誓，餘生都遵循他的教誨嗎？

scripts.text: I do.
scripts.translation: 我願意

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不願意

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Now, you have completed your oath of Priesthood and accomplished all three trials required to become a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
你已完成牧師宣誓，成為牧師所需的三重試煉，也全部完成了。

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Now go to Bishop Paul. And remember, we are all brothers and sisters in the eyes of God. Peace be with you...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
去找保羅主教吧。
記住，在上帝眼中，我們都是兄弟姐妹。
願平安與你同在...

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
...

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
...
......

[Sister Cecilia]
You've come so far...
Why would you want
to throw this all away...?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
已經走到這一步...為什麼要放棄這一切...？

scripts.text:
[Sister Cecilia]
Peace be with you...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亞修女]
願平安與你同在...

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Welcome!
Brother {0}!
So good to see you again!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
歡迎，{0}兄弟！
很高興又見到你！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Welcome!
Sister {0}!
So good to see you again!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
歡迎，{0}姐妹！
很高興又見到你！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Welcome~!
I congratulate you
for passing the first trail.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
歡迎~！
恭喜你通過了第一項考驗。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Are you ready this time?
Complete this trial quickly,
and become a Priest!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
這次準備好了嗎？
儘快完成試煉，成為牧師吧！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Go back!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
回去吧！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Are you here to help an Acolyte friend for the spiritual training? That's great~ I think you'll do a good job.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
你是來幫服事朋友參加靈性修行的？
太好了~相信你能做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Remember, no matter how much you want to help this Acolyte, this is not your quest.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
記住，無論多想幫這位服事，這都不是你的任務。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
You may assist and lighten your friend's burden, but you take upon this task for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
你可以幫忙減輕朋友的負擔，不過，這份協助是你自願承擔的。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
So...
Are you gonna help him right now?
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
那麼...現在要去幫他嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I am.
scripts.translation: 是的，我要去

scripts.text: Give me a minute.
scripts.translation: 請稍等一下

scripts.text: I changed my mind.
scripts.translation: 我改變主意了

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Go for it! As your Acolyte enters, the test will begin. Now, I will send you to the testing area.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
去吧！你的服事朋友進場後，測試就會開始。
現在送你去考場。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Hm...?
What for?
Well, so long as you arrive in time to help your friend, it will be okay.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
嗯...？為什麼？
好吧，只要能及時趕去幫朋友就行。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Oh...?
Then please,
go ahead. God bless
you, and take care!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
哦...？那請便吧。
願上帝保佑你，保重！

scripts.text:
Welcome~!
I congratulate you
for passing the first trail.
scripts.translation:
歡迎~！
恭喜你通過第一重試煉。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
My name is
Peter S. Alberto.
How is my buddy Paul?
Is he doing alright
these days?
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
我叫彼得·S·阿爾貝托。
我的老友保羅怎麼樣，最近還好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Oh, I keep forgetting that he was promoted to Bishop. I think I'm supposed to call him Bishop Paul, or 'His Excellency.' Haha~
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
哎呀，我總是忘記他已經晉升為主教了。我想我應該叫他保羅主教，或者“閣下”。哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Anyway, let me give you a brief explanation of the spiritual training. Are you familiar with what the spiritual training is for Priests?
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
總之，先簡單說明一下靈性修行。
你瞭解牧師的靈性修行嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 是的，我瞭解

scripts.text: Sorry...
scripts.translation: 抱歉...

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Haha, I like you! But it never hurts to have too much information. The more well informed you are, the more easily you'll pass the test!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
哈哈，我欣賞你！不過，多瞭解一些總沒壞處。
知道得越清楚，越容易通過測試！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Oh, no need to be sorry. I'm here to give you the information you need anyway. So, don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
哦，不必道歉，我本來就是來說明情況的。
別擔心。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
In spiritual training, you will be defeating evil creatures. Creatures of the Undead and Demons are all evil. In choosing to serve darkness, they are our enemies!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
靈性修行中，你要擊敗邪惡的生物。
不死者與惡魔都是邪惡的，既然選擇侍奉黑暗，就是我們的敵人！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
There are too many evil creatures that roam this world against the will of God. Innocents suffer as a result of their malignance.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
這個世界上有太多違背上帝旨意的邪惡生物在遊蕩。無辜的人們因此遭受苦難。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
We, as Priests, are obligated to exterminate all those creatures, thus spreading love and peace.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
我們作為牧師，有義務消滅所有這些生物，從而傳播愛與和平。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
This training will test your ability to eliminate evil. Since this trial is pretty difficult to be accomplished by yourself,
I recommend getting help from a Priest if you can.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
這項修行考驗你消滅邪惡的能力。
獨自完成相當困難，所以可以的話，最好請一位牧師幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
If you are close to a Priest, you'd better ask him to assist you during this trial. Now, are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
如果你和某位牧師關係不錯，最好請他在試煉中協助你。那麼，你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: I'm ready.
scripts.translation: 我準備好了

scripts.text: Please hold on.
scripts.translation: 請稍等

scripts.text: I want to go back.
scripts.translation: 我想回去

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Now, let the spiritual training begin. It's simple. Just kill them all. Show no mercy to the creatures of darkness!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
現在，開始靈性修行。
很簡單，把它們全部殺掉。
對黑暗生物，不必留情！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Now...
Go for it!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
現在...
去吧！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Hm? What is it you need?
Well, no problem. You can
afford to take your time.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
嗯？還有什麼需要？
沒問題，慢慢準備就好。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
What...?
You wanna go back??
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
什麼...？
你想回去？？

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
I understand. I suppose you have some important reason or business that you must attend to. Come back whenever you can.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
我理解。我想你一定有重要的理由或事務要處理。等你方便的時候再回來吧。

scripts.text:
Are you ready this time?
Complete this trial quickly,
and become a Priest!
scripts.translation:
這次準備好了嗎？
儘快完成試煉，成為牧師吧！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Are you ready then?
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
那麼，你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: I'm ready.
scripts.translation: 我準備好了

scripts.text: Please hold on.
scripts.translation: 請稍等

scripts.text: I want to go back.
scripts.translation: 我想回去

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Now, let the spiritual training begin. For the glory of God, for peace on earth, and goodwill towards all men...
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
現在，開始靈性修行。
為了上帝的榮耀，為了世間和平，為了對世人的善意...

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Go...
Kill those
misbegotten creatures!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
去吧...消滅那些邪惡的生物！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Hm? What is it you need?
Well, no problem. You can
afford to take your time.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
嗯？還有什麼需要？
沒問題，慢慢準備就好。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
What...?
You wanna go back??
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
什麼...？
你想回去？？

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
I understand. I suppose you have some important reason or business that you must attend to. Come back whenever you can.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
我理解。我想你一定有重要的理由或事務要處理。等你方便的時候再回來吧。

scripts.text: Go back!
scripts.translation: 回去吧！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Welcome!
Brother {0}!
So good to see you!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
歡迎，{0}兄弟！
很高興見到你！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Welcome!
Sister {0}!
So good to see you!
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
歡迎，{0}姐妹！
很高興見到你！

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Please hold on for a while. Another acolyte is in the training ground right now.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
請稍等，另一位服事正在修行場地裡。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Peace...
Be with you.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
願平安...與你同在。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Are you here to help an Acolyte friend for the spiritual training? That's great~ I think you'll do a good job.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
你是來幫服事朋友參加靈性修行的？
太好了~相信你能做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Well, another Acolyte is in the training ground right now. You'll need to wait a little bit longer...
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
現在另一位服事正在修行，還需要再等一會兒...

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Please come back a little later. If this acolyte's done with the training, I will send you to the training area.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
請稍後再來。
等這位服事完成修行，我就送你去修行場地。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
If you want to take the test, please wait a while and talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
如果你想參加測試，請稍等片刻，然後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
If you want to take the test, please wait a while and talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
如果你想參加測試，請稍等片刻，然後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
When the Priest applicant enters, 5 minutes will be given to complete this trial. Proceed slowly and help your Acolyte.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
申請轉職的服事進場後，這項試煉限時5分鐘。
請穩步前進，幫助你的服事朋友。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Enter through the warp at the end of the hall, where you will be lead to the next test hall.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
通過大廳盡頭的傳送門，你將前往下一個測試大廳。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Remember...
This trial must be
completed within
5 minutes. Best of luck~
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
記住...試煉必須在5分鐘內完成。
祝你好運~

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
I will give you exactly 5 minutes! You must proceed slowly and eliminate the Zombies.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
限時整整5分鐘！
穩步前進，消滅腐屍。

scripts.text:
[Father Peter]
Slay all the zombies and go through the warp at the end of the hall. Make sure that you kill them all.
scripts.translation:
[彼得神父]
消滅所有腐屍，再進入大廳盡頭的傳送門。
務必一個不留。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Whaaaaat...?
What are you
doing back here?
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
什——麼...？你怎麼又回來了？

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Well, look who's the ^660000BMOC^000000 now. That's '^660000B^000000ig ^660000M^000000an ^660000O^000000n ^660000C^000000ampus,' if you didn't know. By the way, I was being sarcastic. You know, if you didn't notice.
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
喲，看看現在誰是^660000BMOC^000000了。如果你不知道的話，那是'^660000B^000000ig ^660000M^000000an ^660000O^000000n ^660000C^000000ampus'的縮寫。順便說一句，我在諷刺你。如果你沒注意到的話。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Are you really
happy being a Priest?
There's no possible way.
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
當牧師，你真覺得開心？
不可能吧。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Alright, alright, for old time's sake, I'll let you pass me. But only this once. But I better not catch you again! This is evil turf, you hear?!
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
好吧好吧，看在老交情上，讓你過去，就這一次。
別再讓我抓到你！這可是邪惡的地盤，聽見沒有？！

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Why...
Hello little Aco.
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
喲...你好啊，小服事。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
You must be here training hard to be a Priest. Funny, I know a lot of God's servants, actually. They tell me that it's really tough serving that God guy all the time. So... So ^666666tiring^000000 and ^666666unrewarding^000000.
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
來這裡刻苦修行，想當牧師吧？
有意思，我還真認識不少上帝的僕人。
他們說，整天侍奉上帝那個傢伙，實在太辛苦了。
那麼...那麼^666666疲憊^000000，又^666666毫無回報^000000。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
I mean, people are always crying to Priests for help no matter where they are. And Priests never get anything in return...
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
我的意思是，無論在哪裡，人們總是哭著向牧師求助。而牧師卻得不到任何回報...

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
It's tragic really, how unappreciated Priests are.
It's so clear that any job is better. Anything at all...
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
牧師這麼不受重視，真慘。
隨便哪個職業都更好，哪個都行...

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Wouldn't life be so much easier if you weren't a Priest? And it'd be so easy. All you'd have to do is quit right now...
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
不當牧師，日子不就輕鬆多了？
而且很簡單，現在放棄就行...

scripts.text: You're right, I quit!
scripts.translation: 你說得對，我放棄！

scripts.text: Out of my sight, demon!
scripts.translation: 滾遠點，惡魔！

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
^660000YES~!^000000 I mean...
Good for you!

[Deviruchi]
Oh...?
Look at the ^660000time^000000.
You better get going.

[Deviruchi]
BWAHAHAHAHAHAH!
GET THE JOKE!?
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
BWAHAHAHAHAHAH!
懂這個笑話了嗎！？

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Out of your sight?
I guess I'm not the
cutest thing you've
ever seen, huh?
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
滾遠點？看來我不是你見過最可愛的傢伙，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
But how about this...? Now, isn't this an attractive sight? A nice, shiny new card. Mint condition. Not too many people have this you know. But I happen to have soooo many, my pockets hurt.
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
那這個呢...？很誘人吧？
一張嶄新閃亮的卡片，品相完美。
沒幾個人有哦，可我偏偏多得口袋都裝疼了。

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Isn't it everyone's dream to have one of these? Think about it, being a Priest can only bring you suffering...
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
擁有這樣一張卡片難道不是每個人的夢想嗎？想想看，當牧師只會給你帶來痛苦...

scripts.text: You're right, I'll take it!
scripts.translation: 你說得對，我要了！

scripts.text: Silence!
scripts.translation: 閉嘴！

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Good choice!
This card can
can be yours...
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
選得好！這張卡片可以歸你...

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Theoretically!
BWAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!
Go and earn it yourself!
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
理論上！
BWAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!
自己去賺吧！

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Did...
Did you just tell
me to shut up?
Oh my God...
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
你...你剛才叫我閉嘴？
我的上帝啊...

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Sorry...
Oh ^660000your^000000 God.
Fine, get going.
But you'll regret
your decision later!
scripts.translation:
[小惡魔]
不好意思...是^660000你的^000000上帝。
行，走吧，不過你遲早會後悔的！

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
What are you doing here? You've already made your choice, there's no going back... Priest.
scripts.translation:
[死靈]
來這裡做什麼？你已經作出選擇，沒回頭路了...牧師。

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
Besides, this is none of your business. Whether or not this Acolyte becomes a Priest isn't up to you. Now get out of here, before I get violent.
scripts.translation:
[死靈]
況且，這不關你的事。
這個服事能不能成為牧師，不由你決定。
趁我還沒動手，趕緊走。

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
Hold on there, Acolyte.
I'm not like Deviruchi,
so I won't mince
words with you.
scripts.translation:
[死靈]
站住，服事。
我不像小惡魔，不會跟你拐彎抹角。

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
Now, why would you want to become a Priest? It's such a worthless, thankless job. If you want, I'll give you the chance to become a Novice. Then you can become something much better!
scripts.translation:
[死靈]
為什麼想當牧師？這職業毫無價值，還吃力不討好。
願意的話，我給你個機會變回初心者，這樣就能選個更好的職業！

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
Of course, I'll let you redistribute your stat points by your base level. Now, isn't that a sweet deal...?
scripts.translation:
[死靈]
當然，還會按你的基本等級，讓你重新分配屬性點。
很划算吧...？

scripts.text: Deal, Deal!
scripts.translation: 成交，成交！

scripts.text: No deal... Doppelganger.
scripts.translation: 我不答應...死靈

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
Good choice~
I shall return your
job to a Novice
as you wish.
scripts.translation:
[死靈]
選得好~如你所願，讓你變回初心者。

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
Now go!!
Never step into
the light again!
scripts.translation:
[死靈]
走吧！！永遠別再踏入光明！

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
I don't think you understood what I just offered. Think about it again. I mean, this is your one and only chance to undo your life mistakes. I mean, becoming an Acolyte?
scripts.translation:
[死靈]
看來你沒聽懂我的提議，再想想。
這是你糾正人生錯誤的唯一機會。
我是說，居然選擇當服事？

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
Just don't become a Priest. I won't ask you more than once. Then you can choose a better job... perhaps a Swordman like me.
scripts.translation:
[死靈]
別當牧師就行，我只問這一次。
你可以選個更好的職業...比如像我一樣當劍士。

scripts.text: I don't want to be a Priest!
scripts.translation: 我不想當牧師！

scripts.text: I'll never listen to you!
scripts.translation: 我絕不會聽你的！

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
Excellent choice. Now, never return to this place. I shall return your job to Novice as you wish.
scripts.translation:
[死靈]
選得好，永遠別再回來。
如你所願，讓你變回初心者。

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
Now go!!
Never step into
the light again!
scripts.translation:
[死靈]
走吧！！永遠別再踏入光明！

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
Hmpf. I admire
your determination.
Okay, you can pass.
For now.
scripts.translation:
[死靈]
哼，我佩服你的決心。
好，暫且讓你過去。

scripts.text:
[Doppelganger]
But if by chance we meet again,
I assure you... You won't be happy at all to see me.
scripts.translation:
[死靈]
不過，若再相遇，我保證...你絕不會高興見到我。

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033All is doom, darkness and despair! Those who love you will betray you, and all that will be left is grieving and fury!^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033一切皆是毀滅、黑暗與絕望！愛你的人會背叛你，剩下的只有悲傷與憤怒！^000000

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033To choose to become a servant of God is to choose eternal pain!
I shall personally see to that, mortal.^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033選擇成為上帝的僕人，就是選擇永恆的痛苦！
凡人，我會親手讓它成真。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033Halt, human.
Who has granted
you passage?^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033站住，人類。誰準你通過的？^000000

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033You still wish to become a Priest?! Fool! Then, I shall not let you pass. Go back. Otherwise, you will not survive.^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033還想當牧師？！蠢貨！我不會讓你通過。
回去，否則別想活命。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033It would be so easy for me to snap your fragile body in twain and grind your bones to dust.
Now, go back mortal!^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033把你脆弱的身體折成兩段，再將骨頭碾成粉末，對我來說易如反掌。
滾回去，凡人！^000000

scripts.text: I'm so sorry. Spare me!
scripts.translation: 對不起，饒了我吧！

scripts.text: God will protect me.
scripts.translation: 上帝會保護我

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033Don't ever come back!^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033永遠不要再回來了！^000000

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033It is no use to feign strength and courage. You are completely helpless before me. Your skills are laughable, and your weapons are but mere toys compared to my power.^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033裝出堅強勇敢的樣子，毫無用處。
在我面前，你無能為力。
你的技能可笑至極，你的武器在我的力量面前，不過是玩具。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033With just a wave of my hand, you will cease to exist. And no one will remember you. Tremble before the might of my infinite magic!^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033只需我揮揮手，你就會消失無蹤。沒有人會記得你。在我無限的魔力面前顫抖吧！^000000

scripts.text: I beg you, don't...!
scripts.translation: 求求你，不要...！

scripts.text: Begone, vile fiend!
scripts.translation: 滾開，邪惡的惡魔！

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033Don't ever come back!^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033永遠不要再回來了！^000000

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033Why...
Why don't you fear me?!
For a frail mortal, you
are quite annoying.^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033為什麼...為什麼不怕我？！
你這脆弱的凡人，真是煩透了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033When next we meet, I will shall escort you to a realm of suffering where you shall spend years immersed in excruciating pain.
Mark my words...^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033下次見面，我會帶你去苦難之境，讓你在劇痛中煎熬多年。
記住我的話...^000000

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
I hate
Priests...
scripts.translation:
[巴風特]
我討厭牧師...

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
I don't have any business with you, servant of God. Just pass through.
scripts.translation:
[巴風特]
上帝的僕人，我跟你沒什麼好說的，過去吧。

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
Greetings.
scripts.translation:
[巴風特]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
...{0}.

[Baphomet]
Yes, human,
I know who you are.
scripts.translation:
[巴風特]
是的，人類，我知道你是誰。

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
I also know that Deviruchi, Doppelganger and the Dark Lord have all failed to convince you to turn away from the Priesthood.
Now, I stand before
you to offer a deal.
scripts.translation:
[巴風特]
我也知道，小惡魔、死靈和暗黑之王，都沒能勸你放棄牧師之路。
現在，我來和你談一筆交易。

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
I can grant you any treasure you desire and infinite power at your fingertips. Powerful weapons that humans have never before seen...
scripts.translation:
[巴風特]
我能賜你渴望的任何寶物，讓你輕易掌握無盡力量。
還有人類從未見過的強大武器...

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
Mountains of zeny that you cannot possibly hope to spend in a lifetime. Though, who's to say that your lifespan should be limited? Fame, power, immortality: It can all be yours.
scripts.translation:
[巴風特]
堆積如山的Zeny，一輩子都花不完。
不過，誰說你的壽命就該有限？
名望、力量、永生，全都可以是你的。

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
I will be yours to summon at anytime. All other humans will dread making you their enemy. You will become the most powerful person in all of history!
scripts.translation:
[巴風特]
我會隨時聽候你的召喚。
所有人類都會懼怕與你為敵，你將成為史上最強之人！

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
Cease this foolishness of pursuing the Priesthood. Make a contract with me. The entire world is yours for the taking.
scripts.translation:
[巴風特]
別再愚蠢地追求牧師之路，和我立下契約。
整個世界，都將任你奪取。

scripts.text: Deal.
scripts.translation: 成交

scripts.text: No, Baphomet. You lose.
scripts.translation: 不，巴風特，你輸了

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
Then we shall form a contract. You won't ever regret this moment...
scripts.translation:
[巴風特]
那麼，我們就簽訂契約吧。你絕不會後悔這一刻的...

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
Follow me.
We will make the
contract in my
sanctum of darkness.
scripts.translation:
[巴風特]
跟我來。
我們將在我的黑暗聖所中籤訂契約。

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
Foolish human...
You have made your choice. I will leave you alone for now, then. However, your training won't be as easy as you think.
scripts.translation:
[巴風特]
愚蠢的人類...
你做出了你的選擇。那麼，我現在就放過你。不過，你的修行可不會像你想像的那麼輕鬆。

scripts.text:
[Baphomet]
I shall be preparing my troops for you. The day will come when I shall enjoy watching you writhe in agony as my fiends slowly devour you.
scripts.translation:
[巴風特]
我會為你準備好大軍。
總有一天，我會欣賞你痛苦扭動的模樣，看我的惡魔慢慢將你吞噬。

scripts.text: Ah yes, so you're the young Acolyte who wishes to become a Priest.
scripts.translation: 啊，原來你就是那位想要成為牧師的年輕服事啊。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
I've received the message from Bishop Paul. Since you made the pilgrimage, I hope you accomplish your goal of becoming a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
我收到了保羅主教的訊息。
既然前來朝聖，願你如願成為牧師。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Also, if you have a chance, please visit this abbey again. It's a sacred place for our Church.
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
另外，如果有機會，請再次造訪這座修道院。它是我們教會的聖地。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Well then, please head to your next destination for your pilgrimage. Be safe in your travels.
scripts.translation:
[魯巴爾卡巴拉神父]
那麼，請前往你朝聖的下一站吧。旅途平安。

scripts.text: Please be hurry to the next destination for your pilgrimage. I hope you become a Priest soon.
scripts.translation: 請趕快前往朝聖的下一站吧。希望你能早日成為牧師。

scripts.text: May I ask why you have returned? Please go back and continue your religious practice.
scripts.translation: 請問你為何折返？請回去繼續你的修行吧。

scripts.text: I have no idea what brought you here, but please excuse me.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你為何會來這裡，請原諒我的怠慢。

scripts.text:
Hmm...
It seems you're
training to become
a Priest.
scripts.translation: 嗯...看來你在為成為牧師而修行。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
However, at this point in your pilgrimage, I am not the person that you should be visiting.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
不過，照你現在的朝聖進度，還不該來拜訪我。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Perhaps you should ask Bishop Paul or Sister Cecilia once again. Well, may God be with you...
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
不妨再去問問保羅主教或塞西莉亞修女。
願上帝與你同在...

scripts.text:
Ah, are you
a Priest trainee...?
Welcome!
scripts.translation:
啊，你在為成為牧師而修行...？
歡迎！

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
We Priests are obliged to spread the message of God to
the peoples of the Earth.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
我們牧師有義務向世人傳播上帝的旨意。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
After you become a Priest, your travels may take you to the Morocc Pyramids. I hope that you may release the Undead there from the evil to which they are bound.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
成為牧師後，你可能會去夢羅克金字塔歷練。
願你讓那裡的不死者擺脫邪惡的束縛。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Well then...
I shall pray to
God for safety
on your journey.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂爾達修女]
那麼...
我會向上帝祈禱，保佑你旅途平安。

scripts.text:
Please leave soon, and
continue your training.
scripts.translation: 請儘快出發，繼續修行。

scripts.text: May I ask you the reason you came back? Please continue your training.
scripts.translation: 請問你回來的原因是什麼？請繼續你的修行。

scripts.text:
May God
be with you...
scripts.translation: 願上帝與你同在...

scripts.text:
Hmm...
A Priest trainee, eh?
scripts.translation: 嗯...準備成為牧師的學徒，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Well, you got the wrong person. If you're supposed to meet up with me at all, it'd be later.
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
找錯人了。
就算要來見我，也該晚些時候。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
But that's your own fault.
Now, go back to Church, kid.
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
不過，弄錯是你自己的事。
回教堂去吧，孩子。

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

就算要來見我，也該晚些時候。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
But that's your own fault. Go back to Church.
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
不過，弄錯是你自己的事。
回教堂去。

scripts.text:
Hmm.
A Priest
trainee, eh? 
Welcome.
scripts.translation:
嗯，準備成為牧師的學徒，是吧？
歡迎。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
I won't say
anything more.
Just devote your
life to God.
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
不多說了，把一生奉獻給上帝吧。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Now go back to church.
Hereby, the first of
your trials is now
completed.
scripts.translation:
[陽介神父]
現在回教堂去。
至此，第一重試煉完成了。

scripts.text:
I told you to go back to church.
Or do you want to live with me here for the rest of your life...?
scripts.translation:
我讓你回教堂去。
難道你想在這裡和我過一輩子...？

scripts.text: Just go be a Priest. This isn't a playground for kids.
scripts.translation: 去當你的牧師吧。這裡不是小孩的遊樂場。

scripts.text: ...Acolyte, you don't have any business with me here.
scripts.translation: ...服事，你沒什麼事該找我。
